refund-policy.label: Refunds
refund-policy.title: Refund Policy
intro: This Refund Policy explains how and when ASHZIZ ("we", "us", "our"), a registered private limited company in India, handles cancellations and refunds for our software and technology services, including websites, mobile apps, web apps, SaaS products, desktop software, AI and WhatsApp automation and related software services. We are honest about how digital work behaves: planning, research, design and development consume real effort the moment we begin, so what we can refund depends almost entirely on the stage your project has reached. This page sets out our stage-based approach in plain terms, so there are no surprises on either side. It should be read together with our Terms and Conditions, which govern ownership, milestones, scope and the wider engagement. All prices are quoted exclusive of 18% GST, which is added on the final invoice. Any approved refund is calculated on the amount actually received by us, net of GST already remitted to the government and any third-party costs already incurred on your behalf.

sections.title: Nature Of Digital Services And How Stage Affects Refunds
body: Unlike a physical product that can be returned unused, a digital project consumes effort as soon as work starts. Discovery discussions, scoping, research, wireframes, design, code, configuration and content all represent hours that cannot be taken back. Because of this, our refunds are stage-based: the earlier you are in the process, the more we can return, and the further along we are, the less remains refundable. The fairest way to read this policy is simple: you are charged for the value already created, and you are eligible for a refund only on value not yet delivered.
items: Refund eligibility is determined by the stage reached, not by a fixed percentage.
Time, research and creative effort already spent are treated as delivered value.
Third-party costs we have already paid on your behalf are not recoverable by us, so they cannot be refunded to you.
Where work is partly complete, we aim for a fair split rather than an all-or-nothing outcome.

sections.title: Cancelling An Engagement
body: You may ask to cancel an engagement at any time by writing to us at ash.zizi67@gmail.com. We will confirm the stage your project has reached, what has already been delivered, and the refund position that follows from the stage-based rules in this policy. Cancellation does not by itself create a right to a full refund: it simply stops further work and fixes the point at which we assess what, if anything, is refundable.
items: Write to ash.zizi67@gmail.com to request a cancellation.
We confirm the stage reached and the resulting refund position in writing.
Cancellation stops further work; it does not reverse value already delivered.

sections.title: Stage-Based Refund Eligibility
body: We assess every refund request against the stage your engagement has reached at the moment we receive the request. As a guide, the points below reflect how we treat each stage. The exact stage and the corresponding amount are confirmed in writing when we respond to your request.
items: Before kickoff (paid but no work started): most refundable, less only the payment-gateway charges and a reasonable administrative cost already incurred.
After discovery or design has started: partial refund only. The completed portion (research, scoping, wireframes, designs delivered for review) is not refundable; the unstarted portion may be.
After development has started: partial or non-refundable, depending on how much has been built. Completed and reviewable work is not refundable.
Delivered or handed over: non-refundable, because the deliverables, source files, code and credentials have already passed to you.

sections.title: Services Under a Written Project Agreement
body: Every engagement is scoped and quoted in a written project agreement. Stage-based refund logic applies to the work agreed there, whether it is a website, app, software build or automation setup. Once delivery begins, the completed portion is not refundable; once the agreed work is delivered in full, it is non-refundable. If you cancel before any work begins, the amount paid is refundable less payment-gateway charges and any reasonable administrative cost already incurred.
items: Before any work: refund of the amount paid, less gateway and administrative costs.
Partway through: refund limited to the clearly unstarted portion of the agreed work.
After full delivery: non-refundable.

The booking amount reserves your slot and funds the initial discovery and planning, so it is generally non-refundable once the project has kicked off. Each milestone is invoiced against work that has been completed and made available for your review, which means a completed milestone is not refundable. Refunds, where applicable, are considered only against amounts paid for milestones not yet started.

A refund can only apply to a paid milestone whose work has not yet begun.
Full ownership, source files, code and account credentials transfer to you on final payment, as set out in our Terms and Conditions. There is no lock-in.

cancellation-policy.title: Cancellation Policy
intro: This Cancellation Policy explains how you can cancel an order, project or subscription with ASHZIZ ("we", "us", "our"), a private limited company registered in India, and what happens to your payments, work in progress, and deliverables once a cancellation takes effect. It should be read together with our Refund Policy, which sets out exact refund amounts, and our Terms and Conditions; the three documents work as one. Our position is simple and honest: the earlier you tell us, the cleaner and less costly the cancellation, and you only ever pay for work that has actually been done and for resources we have already committed on your behalf. All prices referenced are exclusive of 18% GST, which is added on the final invoice, and we issue a proper GST invoice. This policy is governed by the laws of India, with exclusive jurisdiction in the courts of Mumbai, Maharashtra.

sections.title: How to Request a Cancellation
body: To cancel, please send us your request in writing so that we have a clear record and can act on it quickly. Email ash.zizi67@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp at +91 96106 00593, and include your order or payment reference (the invoice number or the Razorpay payment reference) along with the name of the project or service. We will acknowledge your request, confirm the effective date of the cancellation, and tell you in writing what has been completed and what, if anything, is payable or refundable under our Refund Policy.
items: Send the request in writing by email or WhatsApp.
Quote your order or payment reference and the project or service name.
The cancellation takes effect from the date we receive your written request, not before.

sections.title: Cancellation Before Any Work Begins
body: This is the cleanest case. If you cancel after booking but before we have started any work on your project, you receive a refund of the amount paid, less the third-party payment gateway charges (Razorpay) and a small, non-recoverable administrative cost, both of which cannot be reclaimed once a payment has been processed. The exact figures and deductions are set out in our Refund Policy, and we keep the logic consistent across both documents. Where applicable, we will issue a revised GST invoice to reflect the adjusted amount.

sections.title: Cancellation After Work Has Started
body: Once work is underway, charges apply for the work completed and the resources committed up to the date of your written cancellation request. This covers design, development, content, any third-party licences or tools purchased for your project, and the time our team has already spent. We will share a short written breakdown of what has been done. Any balance is then handled in line with our Refund Policy: if you have paid more than the value of the work done, the difference (less gateway and administrative costs) is refunded; if the work done exceeds what you have paid, the shortfall is invoiced to you, with GST added.

sections.title: Custom Milestone Projects
body: Settlement follows the milestone structure recorded in your written proposal before work starts: the agreed advance, any progress payments and final payment before handover. Completed and accepted milestones are payable in full, and a milestone in progress is charged on a pro-rata basis for the work actually done.

An in-progress milestone is pro-rated for work actually done.
The payment split that applies is the one recorded in your signed proposal.

sections.title: Subscription, Retainer, and Recurring Services
body: For recurring services such as support and maintenance plans, and the monthly running cost of AI agents and WhatsApp automation, you may cancel with at least 30 days' written notice. The current paid cycle continues and is honoured to the end of its term, so you keep the service you have already paid for, and there is simply no further renewal after that. Because these are ongoing services delivered during the paid period, fees for the current cycle are not refundable. We will confirm your final service date in writing.

Fees for a cycle already in progress are not refunded, as the service is being provided.

body: Full ownership of your project, including the source files, code, and all account credentials, transfers to you only on receipt of the final payment, exactly as stated in our Terms and Conditions. On a cancellation where the project is not paid in full, ownership of the unpaid work does not pass to you. For the portion you have actually paid for, we may, at our discretion and as a goodwill gesture, share the corresponding completed work or files so that the amount you paid is not wasted. Until full settlement, we retain our intellectual property rights in any incomplete or unpaid deliverables.

sections.title: Cancellation by ASHZIZ
body: In limited situations we may need to cancel an engagement from our side: where a client breaches the Terms and Conditions, remains non-responsive for a prolonged period despite reminders so that we cannot continue, or fails to make a payment that is due. In such cases we will give written notice and, where the situation allows, a reasonable opportunity to put things right first. On a cancellation by us, you remain liable for the work completed and the resources committed up to that point, and any settlement (a refund or a balance due) is calculated using the same logic as a client-initiated cancellation under our Refund Policy.

sections.title: Effect on the On-Time Promise
body: Our On-Time Promise is a delivery guarantee, not a refund or cancellation mechanism. Where we agree a fixed delivery date in writing and we miss it for the agreed scope, 50% of the payment is waived. If you cancel a project before that agreed delivery date is reached, the On-Time Promise does not come into play, because there has been no missed deadline to trigger it. The promise also pauses for any period in which required content, assets, or approvals are awaited from you, so delays on the client side do not create a waiver and do not change how a cancellation is settled.
